snippet.title: | Ultimate Custom Dash Release Trailer |
snippet.description:
So this is Ultimate Custom Dash!
(also referred to as UCD)

This is a big project I have been working on for the past few months :)
Its a FNAF fangame themed around Geometry Dash!
I really hope you enjoy it and I will be fixing and balancing the game if people give feedback so look out for update later maybe :D

I also hope to one day see 50/20 mode beaten on this... although its REALLY hard in this current version and I don't know if its even possible.

thumbnail by @TazGFX  :D

Download the game: https://gamejolt.com/games/UltimateCustomDash/900247

Discord server: https://discord.gg/3DqU9QWkEj
